description: Add a user suspension capability to the admin CLI tool that allows administrators to suspend users via API. This includes updating the user model to track suspension status and implementing a new command in the admin interface.
functional_requirements: Add a 'suspended_at' timestamp field to the user model/response structure to track when a user was suspended
Create a new 'suspend-user' command in the admin CLI that calls the suspend user endpoint
Update the admin client to include the suspend user API method
Ensure the user response in both backend models and frontend types includes the new suspension field
